From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-04-21T09:12:00Z
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: POC org bootstrap & connectivity orchestration

Hi Sam / Priyanka —

Thanks again for the chat earlier. To keep momentum for the POC and hit the close timeline we discussed, I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (redwood-map-v1.xlsx). High-level asks to get the environment live in our MAP: 

- Org bootstrap: please confirm the Org ID you want us to seed the tenant under (we can create a scoped sub-tenant if you prefer).
- API keys: Redwood will generate an ephemeral API key for initial testing (TTL 72h) and a production key after verification. Need the owner contact for key rotation.
- IP allowlist: send CIDR ranges for the allowlist (we'll mirror in firewall + VPC peering ACL).
- VPC peering: propose a 2-hour window for peering and routing validation, target week of Apr 25.

Proposed close timeline: 10 business days from confirmation of Org ID + IP ranges (goal: POC live and smoke tests passing).

Can you confirm Priyanka is the technical lead and share the IP ranges + preferred peering window? We can land the DocuSign for the standard POC Addendum once dates are locked — I dropped a DocuSign placeholder link in the MAP.

Attachments: redwood-map-v1.xlsx (MAP draft)

Thanks — looking forward to locking dates.

Best,
Aditya Rao

Ben / Neha —

Recap from the customer: Org ID VITA-03471, Priyanka is the tech lead, IP ranges received (198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.128/26), peering window Apr 25 02:00-04:00 UTC. They asked for an ephemeral API key (TTL 72h) and a JVM client example to test token refresh.

Can we confirm the following by EOD Apr 24 so I can commit: 
- Neha: generate ephemeral API key with 72h TTL and attach rotation instructions; ensure key is scoped to the POC tenant only.
- Ben: schedule the peering slot on our side for Apr 25 02:00-04:00 UTC and pre-stage route tables; include a quick health-check script for BGP and DNS resolution.
- Legal / Contracts: I will push the POC Addendum to DocuSign once we lock the slot (link placeholder in the MAP).

If any of the asks are risky (TTL, access scope), mark them and we can propose alternate controls (e.g., short-lived session tokens with our relay).

Date: 2027-04-26T16:45:00Z
Subject: Finalized MAP and POC schedule (VITA-03471) — please confirm

Hi Sam / Priyanka —

Thanks for confirming the details. Below is the agreed Mutual Action Plan and owner timeline for the POC. Please reply with a simple "ACK" if the dates/owners work for you or note any changes.

Agreed MAP highlights (short):
- Org bootstrap: Redwood will seed tenant under Org ID VITA-03471 by Apr 23. Owner: Aditya Rao.
- Ephemeral API key: Created by Redwood on Apr 23 (TTL 72h). Owner: Neha Kapoor. Deliverable: key + rotation instructions, sample JVM client.
- IP allowlist: Redwood will apply 198.51.100.0/24 and 203.0.113.128/26 to the POC tenant firewall. Owner: Neha Kapoor.
- VPC peering: Window scheduled Apr 25 02:00-04:00 UTC. Task: Ben to coordinate peering handshake and route validation; customer to validate connectivity in that window.
- DocuSign: POC Addendum sent Apr 24; countersign to complete prior to peering. Link: https://docusign.example/ENVELOPE-12345

Attachments: vpc-peering-diagram.png (network diagram), redwood-map-v1.xlsx (finalized MAP), vitacore-iplist.csv

Next steps (owner + date):
- Apr 23 (Neha): share ephemeral key & JVM sample with Priyanka.
- Apr 24 (Aditya): send DocuSign POC Addendum; Ben to confirm peering scheduling on infra side.
- Apr 25 02:00-04:00 UTC (Ben + Priyanka): run peering, smoke tests; customer to confirm "connectivity OK" by end of window.
- Apr 26 (Aditya): run full POC smoke tests against sample workload; if green, we mark POC pass and discuss next steps for production key provisioning.

Related links: https://hubspot.example/deal/DEAL-8491

Please ACK (or propose edits). Happy to hop on a 20-min call if you want to walk the sequence.

Cheers,
